package rules

import "errors"

var ErrRule = errors.New("invalid or stale game command")

type Command struct {
	Seq      uint64
	Revision uint64
	Kind     string
	Choice   int
}
type Result struct {
	Revision uint64
	Reward   int
}
type Receipt struct {
	Command Command
	Result  Result
}

// 状态整体放在生成 DAO，局内缓存不持有另一个可变副本；失败由正式 DAO undo 回滚。
type State struct {
	Members  []int64
	Revision uint64
	Last     map[int64]Receipt
	Planted  bool
	ReadyAt  int64
	Harvests int
	Helped   bool
}

func New(members []int64, now int64) (State, error) {
	if len(members) != 2 || members[0] <= 0 || members[1] <= 0 || members[0] == members[1] || now <= 0 {
		return State{}, ErrRule
	}
	return State{Members: append([]int64(nil), members...), Last: make(map[int64]Receipt), ReadyAt: 0}, nil
}
func (s *State) Apply(actor int64, cmd Command, now int64) (Result, error) {
	if len(s.Members) != 2 || s.Last == nil {
		return Result{}, ErrRule
	}
	index := -1
	for i, id := range s.Members {
		if id == actor {
			index = i
		}
	}
	if index < 0 || cmd.Seq == 0 {
		return Result{}, ErrRule
	}
	previous := s.Last[actor]
	if cmd.Seq == previous.Command.Seq {
		if cmd != previous.Command {
			return Result{}, ErrRule
		}
		return previous.Result, nil
	}
	if cmd.Seq != previous.Command.Seq+1 || cmd.Revision != s.Revision {
		return Result{}, ErrRule
	}
	reward, err := s.execute(index, cmd, now)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	}
	s.Revision++
	result := Result{Revision: s.Revision, Reward: reward}
	s.Last[actor] = Receipt{Command: cmd, Result: result}
	return result, nil
}

// owner 为 Members[0]，受邀访客为 Members[1]。收益只在收获时领取；访问不延长生产期。
func (s *State) execute(index int, cmd Command, now int64) (int, error) {
	switch cmd.Kind {
	case "plant":
		if index != 0 || s.Planted || cmd.Choice != 0 {
			return 0, ErrRule
		}
		s.Planted = true
		s.ReadyAt = now + 60000
		s.Helped = false
	case "help":
		if index != 1 || !s.Planted || s.Helped || now >= s.ReadyAt {
			return 0, ErrRule
		}
		s.Helped = true
		s.ReadyAt -= 10000
	case "harvest":
		if index != 0 || !s.Planted || now < s.ReadyAt {
			return 0, ErrRule
		}
		s.Planted = false
		s.Harvests++
		return 5, nil
	default:
		return 0, ErrRule
	}
	return 0, nil
}
